name: otame4-work-skills
description: Practical Agent Skills for Japanese job hunting and career change: self-analysis, entry-sheet and resume review, interview preparation, company research, and offer decisions.

plugins.name: otame4-documents
plugins.description: Entry sheets, rirekisho, and shokumu-keirekisho: drafting and review against the question asked, the evidence available, and the character limit. (1 skill)

plugins.name: otame4-research
plugins.description: Company research from primary and official sources with every claim dated and attributed, and close reading of a Japanese job posting's pay and requirements. (2 skills)

plugins.name: otame4-offer
plugins.description: Offer decisions: checking the working conditions an employer has stated in writing, and putting several offers on one basis by separating fixed overtime and unguaranteed bonus from the stated annual figure. (2 skills)
